thread:
Marina Torres: Quick update — rolling out community-translations v0.2.0 now. Adds Japanese (ja) and Korean (ko) quickstarts, new localized examples, and an automated glossary to reduce inconsistent terms. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-translations/releases/tag/v0.2.0 :sparkles:
open-source-bot: Release published: community-translations v0.2.0  assets: quickstarts-ja.zip, quickstarts-ko.zip, glossary.json
Diego Alvarez: Love this. Kudos to the volunteers who did reviews :clap: tagging localization lead @Priya
Priya Nair: Thanks! Japanese examples passed our generation checks. Korean needs one review for honorific usage in examples (see docs/ko/examples.md comment thread).
Ravi Patel: Deploying localized docs to staging now: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/locale/ja and /locale/ko — will smoke test nav and code samples.
Marina Torres: Heads-up: updated MAINTAINERS.md with a new "how to review translations" checklist and added CODEOWNERS entries for /locales/ja and /locales/ko.
open-source-bot: CI: build SUCCESS, i18n-lint SUCCESS, smoke-tests FAIL (ko examples render mismatch). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1802000000/logs
Priya Nair: Noted the KO render mismatch — likely a template variable ordering issue. I'll take a look after standup.
Diego Alvarez: Can we add a short "translation credit" section to the release page? I ran: `git shortlog -sne HEAD ^v0.1.0` to compile names.
Marina Torres: Yes, add credits + contributor guide blurb. Also proposing a small maintainer summit next Wednesday 17:00 UTC to onboard new locale volunteers and walk through the glossary process. Invite will go out.
Ravi Patel: Patch submitted for ko template ordering. CI rerun in ~5m.
open-source-bot: CI rerun: smoke-tests SUCCESS. Artifacts attached.
Priya Nair: Nice! After merge I'll request a native review from community volunteers (posting in #community-contributors).
Marina Torres: Thank you everyone :heart: We'll follow up with a short blog highlighting the glossary approach and volunteer workflow next week. Closing this announcement thread and moving follow-ups to #eng-i18n.
